title: Comparison of Breast Feeding Counseling and Video Demonstration on Exclusive Breast Feeding Rates at 6 Weeks
brief_summary: The investigators hypothesize that counseling of mothers will increase exclusive breast feeding rates at six weeks postnatal age. In developing countries like India,there is shortage of staff and the number of newborns cared is huge. So counseling of mothers for breast feeding becomes difficult. In such a situation using audio-visual aids may be a more practical option to increase breast feeding rates. Therefore the investigators will compare the use of video demonstration with counseling for exclusive breast feeding.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All mothers who deliver at term at Deen Dayal Upadhayay Hospital \[DDUH \]whether booked or unbooked.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Sick mother who is unable to communicate
* Congenital malformation
* HIV positive mother
* Mother on chemotherapy/planned for chemotherapy.
